Application Data.NAME: Elegant Interiors, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Interiors, LLC specializes in residential interior decorating and design services, offering comprehensive solutions including space planning, color consultations, furniture selection, and the provision of soft furnishings. Our firm engages in the careful selection of materials and decor elements while ensuring no structural alterations are made. We incorporate limited retail sales of home decor items, such as lighting fixtures and decorative accessories, maintaining strict separation between our design and installation activities. We prioritize client satisfaction and risk management through detailed project documentation, including contracts and change orders, alongside secure digital storage solutions to protect client information. Our operations uphold a commitment to quality and compliance with industry regulations, ensuring a professional and safe environment for our clients and their properties.
